comments.value: Right now this is just venting. If you were to clarify what's wrong with linking accounts, could have something there. Personally steam works for me, so I'm curious what you have against it.

@{62df7cd83e007e467295c4e1|full_name}   so far i know if you link your account to steam its bound to it right (linking accounts is permanent and cannot be undone)! so if i would switch my steam account or something would happen to it what would i do then ? if something happens to my steam account i bounded it to can i access my linked vrchat account on a new steam account ! and even if i would be able to access the vrchat account at that point i couldnt bind it to a new account and would be in the same position as before! and just simply why do i as a consumer who created an account on there website to access there game should have to go and link accounts to get a feature that is s normal standard in every game ? every game that has an option to log in with there dedicated account keeps you looked in and has the small rememeber me /remember this device box,  and it works fine , non of them have a requerment to link account to stay logged in ! its just as simple you are given options how to access vrchat right, create an account on there website, steam or meta etc. non of them by creating one of those accounts says its mandatory to link them all together , and every one should work on there own, but now you have to link accounts to access basic features ? and bring the linked accounts in danger because they are linked ? here is an example for your from a bit ago that happened to a friend of mine, he was playing some shooter game ( dont remember the name anymore ) and one of our other friends convinced him to link his acount to steam !  his steam account got hacked ! and with it all the access to the other games account/ all the progress and everything, besides the hacker almost maneged to scam some people from the frined group pretending he was the account owner ! all this thanks to a linked account ! this is the reason why vrchat should have a simple rember me box for what ever account type ypu use to play vrchat ! do you understand why now :)

@{66b3fbaea877fcfa5738a441|full_name} I had to log into VRChat with my user account to use the Build and Test for worlds, been at least 3 days so far.  It runs the steam version of the game, as my play time is going up, but it did not give me a choice to log in via steam. Username, Password, code kind of thing.

Usually when I switch between steam and meta I have to click the button on the right every time I switch. Cruising through this week.

I guess I can update this when I need to log in again.

Sounds like your friend got their steam account hacked, and then didn't notice for awhile? I've had the same steam account for many years. 

Maybe make a support ticket and as casually as you're able to, just ask them to look into why you're not staying logged in?

Hi Support, I've noticed that the VRChat keeps asking me to log in every day, but I spoke to someone and they stay logged in for longer. Is there anything wrong with my account?

(There isn't anything wrong with your account, just go with it)

details: Vrchat keeps you normaly logged in when you log in ! but for me and a lot of other people i asked it logs them out after 24 hours!  wen need a "remember me" button like every game thats online has ! this issue is only on vrchat pc  ! on mobile it stays logged in the whole time. this would help alot of people to sayed logged in when they start the game and remove the huge discomfort of loging in every day.! every game that is online has this from huge company game to single developer games that were made in one day! why does vrchat dont have this on pc ( and no linking your VrChat accout to steam is not the soluttion ) it sould have a box next to the option wenn you log in with your VrChat account that says "remember me " and if you check in the box it should keep you logged no matter how oftzen you restart the game, util you decide youself to click on the log out option, then the game should log you out of that account and not every 24 hours!
title: Remeber me log in box !
